name: Eastmoon Ruins
summary: Dunemaul ogres occupy Eastmoon Ruins, west of the Gaping Chasm in eastern Tanaris. Their camp stands among the remains of an ancient troll site.

sections.title: Stones in the Sand
sections.body: West of the Gaping Chasm, old troll stones rise from Tanaris’s desert sands. Their pillars and plazas have crumbled with age. Now Dunemaul ogres shelter among the broken walls and watch the nearby trade routes.

faq.answer: Ancient trolls built Eastmoon Ruins. Their stonework and plazas remain in the desert, worn by time.
Dunemaul ogres occupy Eastmoon Ruins now. They camp among the old walls and watch over eastern Tanaris.

faq.q: Where are the Eastmoon Ruins located?
faq.answer: Eastmoon Ruins lie in eastern Tanaris, just west of the Gaping Chasm.

faq.q: Are there any quests in Eastmoon Ruins?
faq.answer: Eastmoon Ruins are a Dunemaul ogre camp and an old landmark in the deeper desert. You can explore the surrounding area, though no work is directed specifically to the ruins.

angles.text: As a troll, you can see a reminder of your ancestors’ reach across Kalimdor before the desert sands claimed the south.
As a rogue, you can use the broken pillars and walls to slip past or ambush Dunemaul ogres along the perimeter.
